en: I built a learning-scale enterprise knowledge and agent platform in Python and FastAPI. Documents are parsed, chunked and indexed twice: in Elasticsearch for BM25 and in Qdrant for embeddings. Queries go through optional query rewriting, parallel keyword and vector retrieval, Reciprocal Rank Fusion and a local LLM reranker, and answers carry numbered citations with document version and source. Around that there's a governance lifecycle, ACL enforced at retrieval time, a Neo4j GraphRAG path, entity resolution, and an evaluation service that scores retrieval and generation separately.

On top, I built the agent twice, on purpose: first framework-free, with schema-validated actions, budgets, human approval and idempotent writes; then as a LangGraph state graph with one model-driven planning node, deterministic verification, a checkpointed approval pause and an execution ledger. I kill the process right after the write, resume, and prove from the ledger that nothing was duplicated. Knowledge search is also a read-only MCP server. I evaluate the agent with 21 golden and adversarial tasks over repeated trials, reporting pass@1, pass^k and an unapproved-writes invariant that must stay at zero.
zh: 我用 Python 和 FastAPI 做了一个学习规模的企业知识与 Agent 平台。文档经过解析、分块，并被索引两次：Elasticsearch 做 BM25，Qdrant 存 embedding。查询经过可选的查询改写、并行的关键词和向量检索、倒数排名融合（RRF）以及本地 LLM 重排序，答案附带编号引用，包含文档版本和来源。外围有治理生命周期、在检索时执行的 ACL、Neo4j GraphRAG、实体消歧，以及分别评估检索和生成的评估服务。

在此之上，我有意把 Agent 做了两遍：第一遍不用框架，包含 schema 校验的动作、预算、人工审批和幂等写入；第二遍用 LangGraph 状态图，只有一个由模型驱动的规划节点，加上确定性校验、带 checkpoint 的审批暂停和执行账本。我在写入后立即杀掉进程，再恢复，用账本证明没有重复写入。知识检索也作为只读 MCP server 暴露。我用 21 个 golden 和对抗性任务、多次重复来评估 Agent，报告 pass@1、pass^k 以及必须保持为 0 的“未审批写入”指标。

title.zh: 混合检索 + RRF + 重排序 + 指标
实体消歧、近重复、矛盾检测

title.en: Durable LangGraph agent + MCP + eval suite
title.zh: 持久化 LangGraph Agent + MCP + 评估套件

stories.en: The model guessed instead of calculating. → required_tools narrows the schema to the next required tool. Enforce critical steps in code.
stories.zh: 模型没算就猜了答案。→ required_tools 把 schema 收窄为下一个必需工具。关键步骤要用代码强制。

stories.en: Retrieval was perfect (Recall@3 = 1.0) but citation accuracy was 0.5. → Evaluate retrieval and generation separately.
stories.zh: 检索完美（Recall@3 = 1.0），但引用准确率只有 0.5。→ 检索和生成要分开评估。

stories.en: Double approval. → Idempotency key + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING turns the second approval into a read.
stories.zh: 重复审批。→ 幂等键 + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING 让第二次审批变成只读。

stories.en: The schema that broke the model server: Ollama couldn't compile maxLength 2000 plus nested nullable objects into a grammar. → Bisected, flattened, made every field required, added a regression test.
stories.zh: 让模型服务报错的 schema：Ollama 无法把 maxLength 2000 和嵌套可空对象编译成语法。→ 二分排查、扁平化、所有字段设为必填，并加回归测试。

stories.en: My own prompt refactor broke the agent: 'return tool=finish' became 'finish', and llama3 looped on calculate. Unit tests passed; the live eval suite caught it. → Restored the wording, 15/15 on re-run, pinned in a test. Prompts are code.
stories.zh: 我自己的 prompt 重构把 Agent 弄坏了：“return tool=finish”被改成“finish”，llama3 就一直循环调用 calculate。单元测试全过，是线上评估套件发现的。→ 恢复原措辞，重跑 15/15 通过，并用测试锁定。Prompt 就是代码。

stories.en: Crash after the write. → LangGraph re-runs the unfinished node; the ledger check returns the existing receipt instead of writing again.
stories.zh: 写入后崩溃。→ LangGraph 会重跑未完成的节点；账本检查返回已有回执，而不是再写一次。
